title: Not another subsidy package — Kerala needs a blueprint for 2030
description: As Kerala’s new government presents its first Budget, this article argues that the state cannot compete through subsidies alone. Instead, Kerala must build a credible investment ecosystem based on regulatory certainty, labour flexibility, innovation, industry-academia collaboration, and quality of life […] The post Not another subsidy package — Kerala needs a blueprint for 2030 appeared first on Centre for Public Policy Research (CPPR).
